business_summary: Access Group Holdings Co., Ltd. engages in human resource solutions, educational institution support, and promotion support businesses. It produces various promotional materials to web-related production and promotion, media liaison, and event planning and execution. The company also plans and manages job information websites and joint company information sessions to produce various promotional materials, such as web content, print materials, and novelty items; and human resource solutions. In addition, it plans and manages college information websites, college information magazines, joint newspaper projects, and joint information sessions, as well as produces various promotional tools, such as websites and school brochures, and propose systems. Further, the company provides public relations and operational support services for educational institutions, including school corporations, and prospective students. Additionally, it is involved in management consulting services; operates and manages seminar space; and offers outsourcing management services comprising human resources, general affairs, systems, and accounting. Access Group Holdings Co., Ltd. was founded in 1982 and is headquartered in Minato, Japan.
